_about: Hugh MacDiarmid. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Complete Poems. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

macdiarmid-drunk-man-looks-at: A drunk man looks at the thistle

macdiarmid-drunk-man-looks-at.year: 1926 (PG title page: Edinburgh and London, William Blackwood & Sons)
macdiarmid-drunk-man-looks-at.evidence: PG header read: original publication Edinburgh: William Blackwood & Sons, 1926; title page lists Sangschaw (1925) and Penny Wheep (1926).
macdiarmid-drunk-man-looks-at.case: Bloom lists the Complete Poems (1978, not PD as a book); his first three books -- Sangschaw (1925), Penny Wheep (1926) and A Drunk Man Looks at the Thistle (1926), his masterpiece -- are US-PD and are the PD core of it.
macdiarmid-drunk-man-looks-at.note: Partial: everything after 1930 (most of the Complete Poems) is not PD. Sangschaw (1925) was not found on PG or as a free IA scan in this pass. PG also has Albyn (1927, prose) -- not on Bloom's list.
